defect: POST /api/comms/[id]/resend re-sent a stored case_invite body verbatim; after the posting's intake was stopped it mailed an apply link answering 410.
mapping: A case_invite outbox row's ref is the pipeline entry id; the posting is identified only by the apply token in the body (/devcase/apply/<token>), the same join devcase-invite-binding.ts and stage-hooks-homework.ts use. Closed = dev_postings.status != 'open' (the apply page / submit routes answer POSTING_CLOSED 410).
fix: route.ts: caseInviteLinkIsDead(body, ws) - every apply token in a case_invite body must resolve via getPostingByToken to an OPEN posting of the same workspace; otherwise jsonRefusal('POSTING_CLOSED', 410), placed after the SIM refusal and before the rate limiter, dedup read and sendComm.
code: POSTING_CLOSED reused (existing code, documented 410); no new code, no catalog change
client_door: resendDoorOf not changed: outbox rows carry no posting status, so no client can withhold the button; the server refusal is the guard and resendOutcome maps it to 'refused' with the code, rendered via useErrorMessage.

red_before_fix: closed posting -> 410 POSTING_CLOSED, no recovery row
green_control: rejection naming a closed posting's link re-sends 200

gates.test_perf: exit 0; share = 0 new modules (getPostingByToken comes from db/devcase, already on the route graph)
